entities.name: Evangelical Reformed Church in Vilnius
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Evangelical Reformed Church is a Continental Reformed Protestantic church in the Vilnius Old Town which was built in 1830–1835 according to a project of Karol Podczaszyński. In 2008 a new organ was installed in the church.
